text:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: PAGED @sara_prod @ajenkins @tim_oncall — hosted-api us-west request queue growing fast, p99 > 45s, errors increasing. Please investigate.

sara_prod: on it, grabbing logs and dashboard links.

ajenkins: seeing GPU pool exhaustion in us-west-2. provisioner spamming errors, autoscaler not creating new instances. logs show cloud API 429s and node creation pending.

tim_oncall: copy. Are fallbacks enabled? can we route traffic to eu-west for non-low-latency tenants?

sara_prod: fallbacks are on but most traffic pinned to us-west by region policy. starting quick tenant-level throttle for non-critical tenants.

ajenkins: paste of recent error snippet:
```
provisioner: create_instance failed: 429 QuotaExceeded - Requested GPUs exceed quota for project
autoscaler: scale_to 0 -> 0 (rate-limited)
kube: node pending: Insufficient GPU quota
```

alyssa_sre: metrics snapshot: p95 jumped from ~1.2s to 6.5s in 7m, p99 from ~5s to ~48s. error rate (timeouts) 0.5% -> 12%. queue length for hosted-api-main: 23k -> 87k.

tim_oncall: immediate mitigations: 1) enable cross-region fallback (route eligible tenants to eu-west) 2) lower model shard to smaller variant for high-latency path 3) manual throttle for batch/marketing tenants. applying 1 now. setting env ROUTE_FALLBACK=true

sara_prod: kicked canary route to eu-west for 10% of traffic. monitoring. starting manual spin-up of reserved GPUs in dedicated pool (need cloud approval).

ajenkins: manual spin-up blocked: cloud account hitting per-region GPU quota. provisioner retrys failing with 429 and then backoff. autoscaler shows config bug: ephemeral_pool.scale_target was 0 after midnight rollover.

customer-support: FYI CS teams — we have elevated incidents from ACME, FastShop, Mailly. CS already notified top customers and opening support threads.

pagerbot: incident severity set to SEV2. page time: 00:09 since alert.

alyssa_sre: mitigation status update: - enabled tenant throttle (50 rps per tenant for batch tags) - deployed smaller-model route for beta path - lowered batching to 1 for latency-critical route. p95 improved to ~3.9s, p99 now ~12s (partial relief). error rate down to ~3.2%.

tim_oncall: opened infra PR to request quota bump in cloud-account infra-project: infra/ops#422 (link). tagging cloud on-call.

ajenkins: short root-cause notes: autoscaler hit cloud API rate limits during rapid scaling window + a midnight rollover bug set ephemeral pool target to 0. Combined effect: no new GPU capacity while queue surged.

sara_prod: temporary plan: keep tenant throttles + cross-region routing + smaller-model path until quota bump or manual capacity approved. will prepare a status page update in 30m.

alyssa_sre: assigning postmortem owner -> @alyssa_sre. Can someone draft initial customer-facing blurb? I'll take the technical postmortem.

sara_prod: I'll draft the customer blurb and DM legal + account teams. posting to status.redwood.com in ~30m.

tim_oncall: handing overnight watch to @ajenkins. notes: monitor queue length, p99, cloud quota request status. escalate to cloud-network if quota request not approved within 45m. :thumbsup:

ajenkins: ack, I'll watch for 2h and escalate as needed. leaving this thread for handoff notes.

pagerbot: auto-note: follow-up checklist created: investigation, quota request, deployment rollback plan, postmortem.

sara_prod: thanks all — keeping channel updated with any changes.
